Commands.FetchPersonBlDescription: Check the BeatLeader statistics of another server member.
Commands.FetchOwnBlDescription: Show your current BeatLeader profile statistics.
Commands.FetchOwnSsDescription: Show your current ScoreSaber profile statistics.
Commands.FetchPersonSsDescription: Check the ScoreSaber statistics of another server member.
Commands.UnlinkDescription: Unlink your Beat Saber account and remove your data from the bot.
Commands.LinkDescription: Link your ScoreSaber or BeatLeader profile to your Discord account.
Commands.CancelDescription: Cancel your current challenge (will grant victory to your opponent).

Commands.SetFeedChannelDescription: Set the current channel to display general player activity.
Commands.SetScoreChannelDescription: Set the current channel to display new scores.
Commands.RemoveChannelDescription: Remove the bot configuration in this channel to stop notifications.
